marks.label: Layout ▾ · Columns · Gutter · Page — the figure's shape, its grid and its page
Grid · Snap to grid · Ruler · zoom — editing aids, never exported
Align all — axes and letters in one click; Align ▾ for each on its own, and equal sizes

Front · Back · lock · Group · Duplicate — for the picked panels
Insert ▾ — another graph, a picture, or a text / arrow / line / box / ellipse on the figure
Style ▾ — match every panel to one, a style preset, or your house style
